answer: Flooding registration pushes an copycat to the back of the basalt queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1814 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the oasis. The summit index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Each impostor pays 2 dollars up front. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
